## Task the agent was given

The task was in the `protonmail/webclients` repository. The requested change was to implement proper Punycode handling for URLs to reduce IDN phishing risk.

The problem statement required:

1. Add/implement `punycodeUrl` in `packages/components/helpers/url.ts`.
   - It should convert Unicode hostnames to ASCII/Punycode.
   - It should preserve protocol, path, query, and fragment.
   - It should clean only the root trailing separator according to the hidden tests: `https://example.com/` should become `https://example.com`, while deep paths like `/path/` should remain `/path/`.

2. Add/implement `getHostnameWithRegex` in `packages/components/helpers/url.ts`.
   - It should extract a hostname using a regex.
   - It should reduce that hostname to the canonical matching key used by domain checks.
   - It needed to handle nested subdomains and multi-level suffixes such as:
     - `https://www.mail.proton.me` → `proton`
     - `https://calendar.proton.me` → `proton`
     - `https://secure.login.example.co.uk` → `example`

3. Update `useLinkHandler` in `packages/components/hooks/useLinkHandler.tsx`.
   - It should apply Punycode conversion to external links before processing.
   - It should use the canonical link source.
   - It should preserve authored deep-link paths.
   - If no URL can be extracted, it should emit an error notification and stop external-link processing.

The blocker registry for the task contained three ambiguity/clarification items:

- How to reduce nested hostnames into the canonical matching key.
- What `punycodeUrl` should return for malformed/unparseable input.
- Whether trailing slash removal applies to all paths or only root paths.

The hidden test patch checked exactly these cases:

```ts

expect(getHostnameWithRegex('https://calendar.proton.me')).toEqual('proton');
expect(getHostnameWithRegex('https://secure.login.example.co.uk')).toEqual('example');

expect(punycodeUrl('not-a-valid-url')).toEqual('data:,not-a-valid-url');
expect(punycodeUrl(':::invalid')).toEqual('data:,:::invalid');

expect(punycodeUrl('https://www.äöü.com/')).toEqual('https://www.xn--4ca0bs.com');
expect(punycodeUrl('https://www.äöü.com/path/')).toEqual('https://www.xn--4ca0bs.com/path/');
expect(punycodeUrl('https://www.äöü.com/a/b/?k=v#end')).toEqual('https://www.xn--4ca0bs.com/a/b/?k=v#end');
